disposition_reason: Fifteen elements including Pb, Cd, As, Cr and Ni were measured by ICP-MS in 30 traditional cheeses (six each from five Southeastern Anatolian provinces); Table 3 gives overall statistics and Table 4 per-province mean ± SD or median (range).

study.design: Retail survey of five traditional provincial cheese types, six samples each
study.origin: traditional cheeses produced in Mardin, Şırnak, Batman, Diyarbakır and Şanlıurfa provinces
study.market: different retail stores in each production province, Türkiye
study.period_text: second half of September to end of November 2020
study.method: Microwave digestion of 0.2 g with 70% HNO3; ICP-MS (Bruker Aurora M90)
study.qa: Calibration standards re-measured every ten samples; no CRM or recovery reported
